test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: Who among the following is considered as the creator of Shore Temple at the group of monuments in Mahabalipuram?
solution:
• **Narasimhavarman II** of Pallava dynasty is considered as the creator of Shore Temple at the group of monuments in Mahabalipuram.
 
• It has been classified as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• It was built around 700-728 in the Mahabalipuram, which is currently in Kanchipuram district of Tamil Nadu.
 
• The temple was referred to as the site Seven Pagodas by Marco Polo and various European merchants.
